description: The one username rule for the whole of LynkOmni (blueprint 44 B, owner approved 2026-11-08): shop, business, person, developer app, partner and agent point. Exact Instagram format, 3 to 30 characters: a to z, 0 to 9, full stops and underscores; not case-sensitive (stored lowercase); never a full stop at the start or the end, never two in a row; the same in every language. Shown as @name, without the @ in addresses. Reserved words and web-address-like endings are refused; a name that differs from a reserved one only by look-alike letters is held for review; a username belongs to its owner forever and is never reissued. Names (free text) are not usernames. core/usernames.py (Python) and ts/src/usernames.ts (TypeScript) implement it; contract/vectors/usernames.v1.json proves both.

ownership.one_owner: a username is tied to the owner's public id (LOOID- or LynkID), never to a device or a staff member
ownership.never_reissued: a changed or released username stays reserved to the same owner forever; old links and QR codes redirect to the new one and can never point to someone else
ownership.taken_in_the_cloud: a shop set up offline uses a temporary address until it is online, so two shops can never take the same username
ownership.disputes: a trademark owner claims a username through safety@; staff decide and record the reason; the old owner keeps a redirect for 90 days
